sql: WITH pagamentos AS (SELECT num_doc_credor, SUM(CAST(vlr_pag_fonte AS DECIMAL)) AS total_pagamentos FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND COALESCE(nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' AND num_doc_credor NOT IN ('-1', '0') GROUP BY num_doc_credor), transferencias AS (SELECT "CÓDIGO FAVORECIDO" AS num_doc_credor, SUM(CAST("VALOR TRANSFERIDO" AS DECIMAL)) AS total_transferencias FROM cgu_transferencias WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 GROUP BY "CÓDIGO FAVORECIDO") SELECT p.num_doc_credor, p.total_pagamentos FROM pagamentos p JOIN transferencias t ON CAST(p.num_doc_credor AS VARCHAR) = CAST(t.num_doc_credor AS VARCHAR) ORDER BY p.total_pagamentos DESC LIMIT 3;
